name: Nevada County Business Network (NCBN)
description: A local network of business owners oriented toward collaboration, service, and long-term stewardship. Alignment matters more than scale. Teamwork and servant leadership are the filter.

name: 246 Happenings
description: A community events platform rooted in shared experience, creativity, and presence. Volunteers are welcomed, included, and rewarded for helping bring events to life and expand local awareness.

name: Network School
description: As an ambassador, my focus is on serious conversations around startup communities and startup countries. This is for pioneers interested in visiting, learning, contributing, and testing new social and economic models.

name: AI & EdTech MasterMind
description: A gathering point for early adopters and builders working at the intersection of AI, technology, and the future of education. Exploration, implementation, and real-world experimentation over theory.
